system.description: A gruelling process of removing your organs one by one and preserving them in alchemical jars.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you know at once if anyone touches the jars.
outcomes.success: You hide your life outside your body. If you die, your soul does not depart but stays in the jars. Anyone who has them can bring you back, without a test or ember, as long as a new body is provided.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails, and you must wait a Downtime to recover before trying again.
outcomes.ruin: The jars hold your soul, but you are still alive: you are Doomed until the ritual is undone. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
